# Nolan's Consulting

> Nolan's Consulting (also known as Nolan's Consulting Solutions) is a US generative engine optimization (GEO) consultancy. We help businesses get found and described accurately by ChatGPT, Google's AI and other AI assistants. We test the questions buyers ask, fix the sources behind the answers, and report what changed every month. Founder: Cheyenne Nolan.

Nolan's Consulting is independent and is not affiliated with OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Perplexity or Anthropic. We do not promise rankings, mentions, traffic or sales; we promise documented work and reporting.

## Services

- [ChatGPT Launch](https://nolansconsulting.com/#chatgpt-launch): $500 one-time. For US online stores and online-service businesses. Includes a ChatGPT visibility audit, help claiming and verifying the business in ChatGPT's Business Hub, a business agent build if the business is eligible, an AI-readability check of the website, and a launch report. Delivered within 7 business days after the client completes verification. The full $500 is credited toward the first month of Focused GEO if the client upgrades within 30 days.
- [Focused GEO](https://nolansconsulting.com/#pricing): $3,000 per month. One website and one priority offer; five buyer questions tested in two AI search experiences; month-one baseline and ranked fixes; up to three approved page updates per month; one revision round and a documented retest; monthly evidence report and 30-minute review.
- [Full GEO](https://nolansconsulting.com/#pricing): $8,000 per month. One website and up to three offers; fifteen buyer questions tested in three AI search experiences; broader offer and buying-decision coverage; two expert interviews per month; up to eight approved page updates per month; one revision round and a documented retest; two working sessions, monthly evidence report and next priorities.

## How the work runs

1. Agree on the buyer questions and AI assistants to test.
2. Record the evidence: date, answer, cited sources and screenshots.
3. Find the page or missing fact behind each finding, ranked by importance to buyers.
4. Make approved changes. The client confirms facts and approves every change.
5. Retest and report what improved, what didn't and what comes next.
